entries.title: Survey Migration
entries.desc: Copy surveys between Qualtrics instances. Pick multiple surveys, migrate in one click, get a full ID mapping report.

entries.title: Library Message Migration
entries.desc: Move library messages across instances. Libraries are loaded automatically so you never need to look up an ID manually.

entries.title: Data Preparation Tools
entries.desc: Four tools built into the toolkit: CSV Comparator with Qualtrics SDS validation, CSV Data Prep for cleaning and splitting, CSV Merger, and Excel Merger. All processing stays in the browser.

entries.title: Get Ticket Statuses
entries.desc: Pull all configured ticket statuses for your brand in one request. Requires the Closed Loop Follow Up subscription.

entries.title: Result Cards
entries.desc: Bulk operation results now show as structured cards with a stats summary, per-row status, and a Download Report button.

entries.title: Help Panel
entries.desc: The sidebar help card has moved to a slide-in panel with more room, collapsible sections, and links to API docs and Pirai AI tools.

entries.title: Ticket Update Rate Limiting
entries.desc: Ticket updates now batch at 45 requests and pause automatically for 61 seconds before continuing, keeping you within Qualtrics limits.

entries.title: Update Ticket and Additional Data
entries.desc: Bulk update ticket fields and custom data fields from a CSV file.

entries.title: Upload Automation File
entries.desc: Upload files directly into Qualtrics automation workflows, up to 500 MB.

entries.title: Insert Embedded Data Fields
entries.desc: Add embedded data fields to any survey in bulk using a CSV.

entries.title: UI Refresh
entries.desc: New design using the Pirai AI identity: white surfaces, blue to purple gradient, Inter typeface.

entries.title: Get Survey
entries.desc: Pull the full survey definition for any survey by ID.

entries.title: Bulk Update Responses
entries.desc: Update embedded data across multiple responses at once from a CSV file.

entries.title: Update Progress
entries.desc: Check the status of a running bulk response update job.
